summary: Chat Markdown lists now show bullets and numbers by default. GFM tables render when you pass remark plugins through the new AiChatProvider `markdown` prop.
howTo: Run `bun add remark-gfm`, then pass `markdown={{ remarkPlugins: [remarkGfm] }}` (memoized) to AiChatProvider. Lists now get markers by default, so remove your own list or table CSS workarounds (for example `list-style` overrides) unless you want a different look.
